source: 上外版必修第三册 Unit 3 Grammar in Use:Ellipsis(省略)。三类:并列句/简单句中避免重复的省略、状语从句中主语+be 的省略、不定式 to 的省略与答语/对话省略。句子地道、答案唯一、零术语。

points.point: 并列句/简单句省略(避免重复)
points.overview: 当 and / but / or 连接的两部分共用相同的动词、主语或成分时,后半部分把重复的词省去:I like tea and (I like) coffee;She can swim but I can't (swim)。

points.point: 状语从句省略(主语与主句一致且含 be)
points.overview: when/while/if/though/as 等从句的主语与主句相同且含 be 动词时,可省略「主语+be」:when (you are) young;if (it is) necessary;though (he was) tired。

points.point: 不定式 to 的省略 & 答语/对话省略
points.overview: 为避免重复前面出现过的动词,只保留 to:I'd love to (go);want to / would like to 后动词省去。答语中也常省略已知信息:Yes, I'd love to。

questions.stem: "Xiaohan is going on a diet, but I don't think Xiaosong ____."
questions.explanation: 省去重复的 go on a diet,用助动词 will 收尾即可。

questions.stem: "My brother likes swimming, and ____ jogging in the morning."
questions.explanation: 并列结构省去重复的动词 like,后半句主语用主格 I。

questions.stem: "Yihui likes reading, Lingyun likes football and Shanshan ____ gardening."
questions.explanation: 三项并列重复同一动词 like,各分句保留 likes(主语第三人称单数)。

questions.stem: "You'd better drink fat-free milk or ____ low-fat milk."
questions.explanation: or 连接的并列,省去重复的情态结构,保留原形动词 drink 与前一致。

questions.stem: "She eats a lot of vegetables, but her brother ____."
questions.explanation: 省去重复的 eat a lot of vegetables,一般现在时否定用 doesn't。

questions.stem: "Too much sugar is harmful to physical and ____ health."
questions.explanation: physical and mental health 共用一个 health,省去重复名词,形容词 mental 直接并列。

questions.stem: "He wanted to go to the gym, but he was too tired ____."
questions.explanation: too...to 结构中省去重复的 go to the gym,只留不定式记号 to。

questions.stem: "I can run five kilometres, but my sister ____."
questions.explanation: 省去重复的 run five kilometres,情态动词 can 的否定用 can't。

questions.stem: "Dark green, red ____ orange vegetables all have high levels of nutrients."
questions.explanation: 三个并列形容词共用一个名词 vegetables,用 and 连接,省去重复的 vegetables。

questions.stem: "Some students skip meals, others eat very little, ____ a few simply fast."
questions.explanation: 并列分句用 and 连接,后句省去重复成分,只保留新信息。

questions.stem: "My friends have different hobbies: Tom likes cycling and Ann ____ yoga."
questions.explanation: do yoga 的 do 不能省,省去的是重复信息;此处保留 does(第三人称单数)接 yoga。

questions.stem: "He looks much healthier than his cousin ____."
questions.explanation: 比较句省去重复的 looks healthy,用助动词 does 收尾。

questions.stem: "We can eat out tonight, or we ____ cook something simple at home."
questions.explanation: or 连接的并列省去重复的 can,后句保留情态动词 can。

questions.stem: "Liz drinks soda while studying, but she knows she ____."
questions.explanation: 省去重复的 drink soda,情态结构否定用 shouldn't。

questions.stem: "Routine chores don't get your heart rate up the way jogging ____."
questions.explanation: 比较中省去重复的 gets your heart rate up,用 does 替代。

questions.stem: "He has already exercised today, but I ____ yet."
questions.explanation: 省去重复的 exercised,现在完成时否定用 haven't(配 yet)。

questions.stem: "Mike runs faster than John ____."
questions.explanation: 比较句省去重复的 runs,用助动词 does 收尾。

questions.stem: "You should reduce salt, ____ leave it out altogether if you can."
questions.explanation: or 连接两个并列建议,后句省去重复的主语 you 与 should。

questions.stem: "My sister got eight hours of sleep last night, but I only ____ six."
questions.explanation: 并列句省去重复的 hours of sleep,保留过去式 got 接 six。

questions.stem: "Some people love morning workouts, ____ others prefer evening walks."
questions.explanation: 前后形成对比,用 but 连接两个并列分句。

questions.stem: "She wanted to join the dance club, and her friends ____ too."
questions.explanation: 省去重复的 wanted to join the dance club,用助动词 did 收尾。

questions.stem: "____ weak and tired, Yutong still went jogging in the afternoon."
questions.explanation: 句意'虽然又弱又累,却仍去慢跑'=Though (he was) weak and tired,从句省去'he was';让步连词用 Though。

questions.stem: "____ young, you should start building healthy habits early."
questions.explanation: When (you are) young '当你年轻时',时间从句省去'you are';连词用 When。

questions.stem: "See a doctor immediately ____ necessary, rather than wait at home."
questions.explanation: if (it is) necessary '如果必要',条件从句省去'it is';连词用 if。

questions.stem: "____ exercising on a regular basis, you also need enough sleep."
questions.explanation: While (you are) exercising '在运动的同时',时间从句省去'you are';连词用 While。

questions.stem: "____ a classic debate, the answer is actually quite simple."
questions.explanation: Though (it is) a classic debate '尽管是个典型争论',让步从句省去'it is';连词用 Though。

questions.stem: "____ in doubt about a symptom, ask a doctor for advice."
questions.explanation: When (you are) in doubt '当你有疑问时',时间从句省去'you are';连词用 When。

questions.stem: "Wash your hands ____ necessary to fight off germs."
questions.explanation: whenever (it is) necessary '每当有必要时',从句省去'it is';连词用 whenever。

questions.stem: "Get eight to ten hours of sleep each night ____ possible."
questions.explanation: if (it is) possible '如果可能',条件从句省去'it is';连词用 if。

questions.stem: "____ at the gym, remember to stretch before you start."
questions.explanation: While (you are) at the gym '在健身房时',时间从句省去'you are';连词用 While。

questions.stem: "____ told otherwise by a doctor, brush your teeth twice a day."
questions.explanation: Unless (you are) told otherwise '除非另有医嘱',从句省去'you are';否定条件用 Unless。

questions.stem: "____ active every day, you will find new habits much easier."
questions.explanation: Once (you are) active '一旦你每天活跃起来',时间从句省去'you are';连词用 Once。

questions.stem: "____ tired after a long day, she still made a healthy dinner."
questions.explanation: Though (she was) tired '尽管累',让步从句省去'she was';连词用 Though。

questions.stem: "____ looking for active events, sign up together with your friends."
questions.explanation: When (you are) looking '当你寻找时',时间从句省去'you are';连词用 When。

questions.stem: "____ in good shape, you can enjoy many more outdoor activities."
questions.explanation: If (you are) in good shape '如果身体状态好',条件从句省去'you are';连词用 If。

questions.stem: "____ drinking water, also remember to eat plenty of fresh fruit."
questions.explanation: While (you are) drinking '在喝水的同时',时间从句省去'you are';连词用 While。

questions.stem: "____ beneficial, a daily morning run can be hard to keep up."
questions.explanation: Though (it is) beneficial '尽管有益',让步从句省去'it is';连词用 Though。

questions.stem: "____ ready, you can begin the new exercise plan tomorrow."
questions.explanation: When (you are) ready '当你准备好时',时间从句省去'you are';连词用 When。

questions.stem: "____ stressed, take a short walk to lower your tension."
questions.explanation: If (you are) stressed '如果你感到有压力',条件从句省去'you are';连词用 If。

questions.stem: "____ on the running machine, keep your back straight at all times."
questions.explanation: While (you are) on the running machine '在跑步机上时',时间从句省去'you are';连词用 While。

questions.stem: "____ busy, try to make some time for gentle movement."
questions.explanation: Even when (you are) busy '即使忙碌时',时间从句省去'you are';连词用 Even when。

questions.stem: "– Would you like to join our dance club? – Yes, I'd love ____."
questions.explanation: 答语省去重复的 join your dance club,只保留 to。

questions.stem: "I don't go jogging now, but I used ____."
questions.explanation: used to (go jogging),省去重复动词,保留 to。

questions.stem: "– Do you want to sign up for the fun run? – I'd really like ____."
questions.explanation: would like to (sign up),省去重复动词,保留 to。

questions.stem: "She doesn't eat much junk food now, though she used ____."
questions.explanation: used to (eat much junk food),省去动词,留 to。

questions.stem: "– How would you like your potatoes? – ____, please."
questions.explanation: 答语省去 I'd like them,只保留过去分词 Boiled。

questions.stem: "I haven't started the new habit yet, but I'm going ____."
questions.explanation: be going to (start),省去重复动词,留 to。

questions.stem: "– Could you brush for two minutes? – Sure, I'll try ____."
questions.explanation: try to (brush for two minutes),省去动词,留 to。

questions.stem: "– Will you exercise on a regular basis? – Yes, I promise ____."
questions.explanation: promise to (exercise),省去重复动词,留 to。

questions.stem: "– Are you going to give up sugary drinks? – I hope ____."
questions.explanation: hope so 替代整句肯定内容,是常见的答语省略。

questions.stem: "– Would you mind opening the window? – Not at all, I'd be glad ____."
questions.explanation: be glad to (open it),省去重复动词,留 to。

questions.stem: "He never used to take a nap, but now he wants ____."
questions.explanation: want to (take a nap),省去重复动词,留 to。

questions.stem: "– Do you think you can become a super-ager? – I'd love ____."
questions.explanation: would love to (become one),省去重复动词,留 to。

questions.stem: "– Has Liz changed her diet? – I'm afraid ____."
questions.explanation: I'm afraid not 替代否定整句,是固定的答语省略。

questions.stem: "You don't have to walk every day, but it helps ____."
questions.explanation: it helps to (walk every day),省去重复动词,留 to。

questions.stem: "– Are you joining the charity walk? – Yes, I'd be happy ____."
questions.explanation: be happy to (join),省去重复动词,留 to。

questions.stem: "– Did Liz skip breakfast again? – No, this morning she chose not ____."
questions.explanation: chose not to (skip breakfast),省去重复动词,保留 to(否定用 not to)。

questions.stem: "– Will you keep track of your sleep? – I'll certainly try ____."
questions.explanation: try to (keep track),省去动词,留 to。

questions.stem: "– Would you like more cabbage soup? – Yes, I ____, please."
questions.explanation: 答语 Yes, I would (like more),省去重复内容,保留情态动词 would。

questions.stem: "I don't usually eat out, but tonight I've decided ____."
questions.explanation: decide to (eat out),省去重复动词,留 to。
